szoveg_eredeti:
Computer managed $30k in Meta ad spend for Get Maine Lobster and outperformed their agency.

Computer researched competitors, created ads, and managed spend.

Compared to the brand’s usual campaign, Computer delivered 3.5x the revenue on 2.1x the spend, with a 63% higher return on ad spend.

E-commerce businesses can use Computer to create ads, build landing pages in Shopify, and run email campaigns in Klaviyo.

It uses your store and campaign data to decide what to make and which products to promote.

Read the story: pplx.ai/gml 

Learn more about Computer for e-commerce: pplx.ai/ecommerce
